dates.name: Utah Mammoth vs. Edmonton Oilers — NHL Hockey
dates.desc: Catch Utah's new NHL franchise against Connor McDavid and the high-powered Edmonton Oilers — one of the marquee matchups of the Mammoth's debut season. The Mammoth also have home games Thu Apr 9 vs. Nashville (7:00 PM) and Sat Apr 11 vs. Carolina Hurricanes (3:00 PM) if this date doesn't work.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: The Phantom of the Opera — Broadway at the Eccles
dates.desc: Cameron Mackintosh's acclaimed new production of the iconic Broadway musical — full orchestra, stunning set design, and one of the most spectacular shows in musical theater. Runs through April 26; also plays Fri Apr 10 at 7:30 PM, Sun Apr 12 at 6:30 PM, and Sat Apr 18 at 7:30 PM if another night works better.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Jazz vs. Memphis Grizzlies
dates.desc: A Friday night Jazz game to close out the week — in a rebuilding year, tickets are extremely affordable and you can grab great seats for cheap. Grab dinner on 300 South beforehand and walk over to the arena.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Grizzlies — Final Regular Season Game Ever
dates.desc: The Utah Grizzlies are being dissolved after this season — this Sunday afternoon matinee is their very last regular season home game in franchise history. An emotional send-off for a team you've loved. Afternoon start means you could pair it with the Journey concert the same night.
dates.where: Maverik Center — 3200 S Decker Lake Dr, West Valley City, UT 84119

dates.name: Journey — Final Frontier Farewell Tour
dates.desc: One of rock's greatest bands on what's billed as their final major North American tour — Don't Stop Believin', Open Arms, Faithfully, and more. An evening with Journey, no opener. Make it an epic Sunday by catching the Grizzlies' historic final game at 3:10 PM before heading over.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Tulip Festival — Friday Evening (Live Music + Food Trucks)
dates.price: $24 - $29/person (save $3 buying online vs. at the gate)
dates.desc: Over 1 million tulips and spring blooms at Ashton Gardens — mid-April is peak bloom week and Friday evenings add a live music lineup (3–7 PM) with food trucks and local vendors, making it a full evening experience. This is the sweet spot of the season.
dates.where: Ashton Gardens, Thanksgiving Point — 3900 N Garden Dr, Lehi, UT 84043

dates.name: Real Salt Lake vs. San Diego FC — MLS Soccer
dates.desc: A Saturday night MLS match at America First Field — RSL hosts the brand-new San Diego FC expansion club in their inaugural season, making for a fun and historic matchup. Outdoor stadium with a great atmosphere and affordable lower-bowl seats.
dates.where: America First Field — 9256 S State St, Sandy, UT 84070

dates.name: Bridal Veil Falls & Provo Canyon Drive
dates.desc: A stunning 607-foot double waterfall at peak spring flow — the short trail to the base is easy and beautiful, and the drive through Provo Canyon is gorgeous in mid-April with wildflowers and rushing water everywhere. Grab lunch at a Heber City spot on the way back for a full half-day.
dates.where: Bridal Veil Falls — Provo Canyon, UT 84604 (off US-189, ~45 min from Lehi)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City
dates.desc: One of Park City's most celebrated restaurants — creative American small plates and hearty entrees in a restored historic building on Heber Ave. Go early enough to stroll Historic Main Street before or after dinner; the whole area is walkable and lively in spring.
dates.where: Handle — 136 Heber Ave, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard
dates.desc: Gamified golf bays with automatic scoring, a full food menu, and zero skill required — a natural next step from mini golf with more variety and a livelier atmosphere. Bay pricing is per bay (not per person), and Tuesdays are half-off gameplay, making it one of the best-value activity dates in Utah County.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059

dates.name: Clark Planetarium + Gateway Stroll
dates.desc: Free interactive science museum with immersive space exhibits and a digital full-dome IMAX theater — hands-on and visual, not a quiet gallery experience. Afterwards, explore The Gateway district just outside for dessert, a stroll, or an arcade bar (mocktails welcome).
dates.where: Clark Planetarium — 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Themed Cook-Off Challenge at Home
dates.desc: Pick a cuisine neither of you has cooked before — Japanese, Moroccan, Thai, whatever sounds interesting — grab the ingredients together, then challenge yourselves to cook a full meal from scratch. Set a timer for each course and see what you can pull off. More fun and chaotic than it sounds.

dates.name: Escape Room at Getout Games — SLC
dates.desc: Four themed rooms downtown — Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room — 60 minutes of puzzle-solving and teamwork under a ticking clock. Book a slot in advance; evenings available through the week.
dates.start: Flexible (book a time slot in advance)
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
